mentions.name: Rust to Fil-ABI compiler backend
mentions.description: A toolchain effort to make Rust compile to Fil-ABI, enabling interop between Rust and Fil-C without weakening either language's guarantees. It is about one-third of the way done and is needed to get librsvg working in Fil-GNOME.
mentions.problem: Rust and Fil-C code need to interoperate without weakening either language's guarantees.
mentions.source_excerpt: about 1/3 of the way through getting Rust to compile to Fil-ABI. This means you can interop between Rust and Fil-C without weakening either language’s guarantees. I’ll need this to get librsvg to work in Fil-GNOME.
